title: Professional Email Annual Conversion: Credit Convention for Unused Days
content:
The credit convention of a Professional Email annual conversion is read from the calendar days from today to the term end date of the paid month:

- where those days are 15 or more, the credited days count day by day;
- where they are from 1 up to 14, only the whole weeks in the credited days count, each as seven days;
- otherwise nothing is credited.

The credit fraction is the credited days so counted divided by the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date.

## Cases (hypothetical 30-day month, credited days equal to the days left)

| Days from today to the term end date | Credited days counted | Credit fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 20 | 20 divided by 30 |
| 15 | 15 | 15 divided by 30 |
| 14 | 14 (two whole weeks) | 14 divided by 30 |
| 10 | 7 (one whole week) | 7 divided by 30 |
| 6 | 0 | none |
